providerAgreement: intake provider must exactly equal the provider component
domain: the complete sourceTarget is the record, burst, inbound dedupe, payload, correlation and freshness domain

syntheticNamespace.rule: synthetic identities outside the diagnostic account are invalid

historicalCompatibility.rule: stored historical account-less records remain readable and auditable but are operationally invalid and cannot append, close, claim, refresh, reserve or merge with v1 domains
